meta.title: Italian to English Voice Translator | IQ Translate
meta.description: Translate Italian to English by voice or text: speak or paste Italian, read and hear the English at once, reply back in Italian. Free, no sign-up.
meta.ogDescription: Speak or paste Italian and get the English meaning in seconds, spoken or written. Reply in English and it goes back in Italian.

hero.title: Italian to English translator
hero.description: Italian is spoken fast and rarely one sentence at a time. Record it or paste it and read the English immediately, then answer in English and let the other person hear it in Italian.
hero.mockFromPhrase: Scusa, mi sa dire dov'è la fermata?
hero.mockToPhrase: Sorry, can you tell me where the stop is?
